title.en: An Act Amending Item Ninety, Group II, Paragraph “m,” for the Province of Camarines Sur, Section Three of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven

text.en:
Item ninety, group II, paragraph "m," for the Province of Camarines Sur, section three of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"90. San Jose Home Economics Building, San Jose—Completion ₱2,500.00."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956.
